votes.motion: A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Zach Robinson, to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Marci Houseman to adopt Resolution 25-40C, a resolution authorizing the execution of an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between Sandy City and South Jordan City for asphalt resurfacing

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Marci Houseman to adopt Resolution 25-41C, a resolution of the Sandy City Council approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement with the Redevelopment Agency of Sandy City, which agreement relates to the purchase of land at 10101 South State Street, Sandy, UT, SL County Parcel Number 28-07-352-011
A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Alison Stroud, to convene a meeting of the Redevelopment Agency Board
